pattern: SELECT ([A-Za-z]+)_date, COUNT\(*\) as total_\w+ FROM ([A-Za-z]+)s GROUP BY ([A-Za-z]+)_date
correction: Replace the COUNT(\*) with SUM() and change the column selection to sum the intended column instead of counting the records.

metadata.description: This rule detects when the SQL query counts the number of records instead of performing a sum operation, as intended.
